status: Partial native Gravebuster lifecycle port; full-game acceptance remains open

compatibility: Old saves without gravebuster state continue eating from existing actionIn
New save snapshots preserve phase, rate and ticks

Native floating point accumulation and exact random sequence have not been compared against a running original engine
Remaining full-game animation, projectile and touch/phone acceptance gaps remain open
